Question it answers: Can non-pixel metadata alone reproduce the discrimination?
This cohort: Combined probe 0.731 at patient level vs locked image model 0.765; probe recovers ~96% of image-model AUROC using no wound pixels
Public contrast dataset: Context probe (location + closure) 0.599; image models exceed it by +0.116 to +0.162 across 7 architecture-seed runs, all P<=0.004
Verdict (this cohort): FAILS - context nearly matches the image model

Question it answers: Does the true wound region outperform area-matched regions placed elsewhere?
This cohort: Over 300 constrained non-wrapping relocations: null mean 0.582, true wound 0.538 at the 23.7th percentile; one-sided P=0.764. Single-shift contrast across 3 seeds: +0.138 (+0.051 to +0.231), Holm 0.008
Public contrast dataset: Not assessable - no wound masks in the public dataset
Verdict (this cohort): FAILS - relocated regions match or beat the true wound

Question it answers: Does discrimination survive stratifying on operative region?
This cohort: Region alone 0.750 (0.633-0.851) vs image model 0.785; stratified 0.664 (0.473-0.829); score encodes region among SSI-negative patients at 0.892. Within-abdomen AUROC 0.466 (0.297-0.635) where 12 of 14 events lie
Public contrast dataset: Not assessable - no patient-level operative region
Verdict (this cohort): FAILS - a one-bit region covariate matches the model

Question it answers: Does discrimination survive removing infections a photograph cannot show?
This cohort: All SSI types 0.754 (0.632-0.861), 14 events; excluding organ-space 0.714 (0.562-0.843), 10 events; also excluding infection remote from the photographed incision 0.724 (0.555-0.864), 9 events. 5 of 20 events are organ-space and 1 is at a different site from the photograph
Public contrast dataset: Not assessable - no SSI depth labels
Verdict (this cohort): NOT SUPPORTED - discrimination falls but intervals overlap; underpowered at 10 events

Question it answers: Does the annotated mask shape alone carry signal?
This cohort: Binary mask as an image 0.465 (0.327-0.601) - no signal. But 7 SCALAR GEOMETRY features (position, size, elongation) give 0.802 (0.680-0.897), higher than the image model; mask area alone 0.600. Fine-tuned confirmation across seeds: 0.564, 0.609, 0.563
Verdict (this cohort): FAILS - annotation geometry alone exceeds the image model

Question it answers: Does the pattern replicate without task-specific fine-tuning?
This cohort: dinov2_vitb14: full 0.725, wound 0.559, background 0.745, shifted 0.653. Paired contrasts (20,000 resamples): 2 of 5 significant - background_only - wound_only +0.186 (+0.014 to +0.370), P=0.033; sham_background_only - wound_only +0.244 (+0.067 to +0.425), P=0.008
Verdict (this cohort): FAILS - DINOv2 ranks the true wound LOWEST, and background-minus-wound and shamBackground-minus-wound are significant on paired tests; BiomedCLIP flat throughout

Question it answers: Can the pipeline learn a strong image signal at all?
This cohort: Early vs late postoperative stage, image-level AUROC 0.976 (0.957-0.990). Note this may itself be acquisition context (dressings, framing), so it bounds pipeline sensitivity rather than demonstrating wound biology

Question it answers: Is the effect a property of the data or of one training run?
This cohort: Three seeds per masking condition. Absolute levels move up to 0.095 between seeds; the sham contrast is stable at +0.123/+0.133/+0.157
Verdict (this cohort): PASSES for contrasts, FAILS for levels
